d: Join us on a non-veg food tour of Bhagalpur with our host Suraj Sourav as we explore some of the city’s much-loved line hotels and local food spots. From rustic Bihari-style mutton and a popular chicken thali to Champaran mutton, a Kolkata-style roll and a unique egg preparation, this is a journey through the hearty, flavourful side of Bhagalpur’s food culture.
